Kit_Torchiere.title: Brass torchiere
Kit_Torchiere.lede: A polished brass halogen uplight on a beaded, terraced base; a stepped frosted glass bowl whose lip shows above a thin brass band; a knurled dimmer on the right side of the cup. Unplugged.

materials.name: Prop_BrassPolished
materials.label: Polished lacquered brass (torchiere-only slot, sRGB 0.95/0.72/0.32, smoothness 0.72; W2 fix 2)

materials.name: Prop_PlasticBlack
materials.label: Black plastic / black-painted steel (felt, cord, plug)

materials.name: Prop_FrostedGlass
materials.label: Frosted (satin-etched) glass bowl, opaque, no normal map; outside lit by tilted normals (W2 fix 2); halogen tube (off)

Kit_TaskChair.title: Task chair
Kit_TaskChair.lede: The armless 1990 office task chair: grey fabric pads, black shell and five-star base, gas lift.

Kit_TaskChair_Navy.title: Task chair, navy
Kit_TaskChair_Navy.lede: The same armless chair in navy fabric: 30 % of Office rooms buy their chairs in navy.

Kit_TaskChair_Armed.title: Task chair with arms
Kit_TaskChair_Armed.lede: The old black operator chair with loop arms, kept as the odd chair at about 15 % of stations.

assets.name: Kit_Torchiere
assets.era_note: After Sears 1993 p.319 item N (66 1/2 in, terraced bowl, gold rim, beaded terraced brass base, switch on the side of the cup); kept a 300 W halogen tube (era lock row 76). Lamp off: no emissive slot. W2 fix 2 (2026-10-22): 6 bands and 5 ledges of 8 mm, glass lip above the band, knob on the cup's side, brass hue set after the grade.

assets.name: Kit_TaskChair
assets.era_note: After Sears 1993 p.359 chairs M/N (armless, contoured seat, pneumatic lift) and p.358 B 'gray nylon upholstery'. W2 fix 2: 2 cm of chrome piston shows; LOD2 is a hand-built proxy.

assets.name: Kit_TaskChair_Navy
assets.era_note: Material variant of Kit_TaskChair (VARIANTS in task_chair.py); Sears 1993 colour '775 Royal navy'. W2 fix 2: 2 cm of chrome piston shows; LOD2 is a hand-built proxy.

assets.name: Kit_TaskChair_Armed
assets.era_note: The pre-W2 Kit_TaskChair, renamed (Red 2026-10-21: keep the black armed one as a variant). Black armed chairs are the minority in 1993 catalogues (R03). Not a pile piece. W2 fix 2: LOD2 is a hand-built proxy (whole star, casters, column, arms).

units.dims_m: metres, [w, h, d] in the FRONT image frame: w across, h up, d front to back (kit +Z is the front)
units.suggested_sheet_scale: px per metre on the 1920 x 1080 K-sheet; every kit here is furniture (>= 0.75 m), so all four share 250
units.tris: LOD0 / LOD1 / LOD2 from the W2 build (kitlib make_lods, LODS ratios in the modules)

images.note: third-angle orthographic at suggested_sheet_scale (1 PNG px = 1 sheet px, place at 100 %), transparent, 16 px clear padding; hero = 1152 x 864, 3/4 from the front-left. Kit front = the seat edge / the dimmer side (+Z). No kit is turned.
images.print: threeview/2x/: the same views at 2x (500 px/m, place at 50 %) with the renderer's manifest.json, for print
